releases.title: Update progress
changes: Follow installation progress in the toolbar and update dialog. The percentage advances as each installation step finishes.

releases.title: Projectchy Discord and quieter updates
changes: Join the Projectchy Discord from the Workspaces footer. Connectchy is moving to its own website.
Removed the Online right now counter from Home and workspace navigation.
Windows update checks and installation helpers now hide their background terminal windows.

releases.title: Update Works From Any Start
changes: The Update button now appears however Connectchy was started: npm start, the launcher, a shortcut, or a plain production server. Nothing has to be announced or installed by hand.
Clicking Update builds the new version beside the running app, then the app restarts itself on the same address. If the new version cannot start, the previous one comes back automatically.
Only real newer releases are offered, so a copy that is already up to date (or newer) never shows an update.
A finished update is remembered, so the next start keeps running the version you updated to.

releases.title: Update Badge and Simple Start
changes: Start Connectchy with npm start - no start file, no manual build and no database setup. The first run prepares everything by itself.
Connectchy now checks GitHub for a new version every 10 minutes. When one is published, the button at the top changes from Changelog to Update.
The download counter was removed from the top bar, so the toolbar only shows what you need: the live number, Update and Changelog.

releases.title: Live Online Counter
changes: The top of every workspace now shows how many copies of Connectchy are running right now, with an animated count that goes up and down as people open and close the app.
Each copy reports itself in the background once per install and leaves when it stops, so the number is live installs rather than page views.
The count is public: it is read back from GitHub without signing in, and the app also shows this computer's own count when GitHub is unreachable.
New installs never need a database URL again; starting the app creates the private local database by itself.

releases.title: New Download Counter
changes: The top of Home and every workspace now shows a Download Counter with the real number of people who downloaded Connectchy.
Open the counter to see Roblox Studio plugin and VS Code extension installs, total files sent, and new installs from the last 30 days.

Downloads are counted by this dashboard's own database when it hands out a real plugin or extension file, once per browser or install. Only a salted hash of a random install id is stored, never an IP address or account.

releases.title: Error Fix
changes: VS Code connects using the port in your local workspace link and remembers it when reconnecting.
Workspace setup now gives VS Code the local link and gives agents their own access link.
Connection errors identify the dashboard address and explain how to reconnect. Download the updated VSIX from workspace setup.

releases.title: Better Design
changes: Chat and Tasks share a sidebar that stays in place when you switch views.
Workspace tools expand and collapse with a smooth transition.
Open the changelog from the top of Home or your workspace.
